title: Adopt a shared responsive breakpoint strategy
context: Prefer shared breakpoint buckets with documented bespoke exceptions, using native CSS and review rather than new dependencies or automated enforcement.

tasks.title: Document and normalize responsive breakpoints
acceptance_criteria: DESIGN.md defines the 30rem, 48rem, 62rem, and 80rem thresholds, mobile-first range syntax, exact-boundary ownership, fluid sizing, image sizes alignment, and commented bespoke exceptions; AGENTS.md links to the strategy.
Existing width queries use native range syntax; existing 48rem transitions remain, About desktop layout and portrait sizes switch at 62rem, and the mobile mosaic applies only below 30rem.
No new dependencies, breakpoint checker, public component APIs, browser JavaScript, or unnecessary 80rem overrides are introduced.

Browser coverage checks below and at 480, 768, 992, and 1280 pixels for navigation visibility, About layout and artwork selection, and horizontal overflow; image-loading assertions reflect the new boundaries.
Representative mobile, tablet, and desktop screenshots are reviewed, and npm run verify passes.

tasks.title: Remove redundant above-breakpoint test iterations
acceptance_criteria: Both responsive test loops use only 390, 479, 480, 767, 768, 991, 992, 1279, and 1280 pixels, preserving existing assertions.
The width-list comment matches the reduced coverage and npm run verify passes.
